$P(36\le X\le54)\approx P[(35.5-48)/\sqrt{28.8}<Z<(54.5-48)/\sqrt{28.8}]$. M1 for substituting their $\mu$ and $\sigma$ into one $\pm$ standardisation formula using any number for 35.5 or 54.5; condone $\sigma^2$ and $\sqrt\sigma$. M1 for using a continuity correction 35.5, 36.5, 53.5 or 54.5 at least once. Seeing $\pm12.5/\sqrt{28.8}$ or $\pm6.5/\sqrt{28.8}$ gains M2 BOD.
Area $=0.8871+0.9900-1$. M1 for an appropriate final probability area; expect final answer greater than 0.5, and a correct final answer implies this M1. $=0.877$. A1 for $0.877\le p<0.8772$. Total [5].
